B_delta_6.description: Retrieval-time fuzzy HS denylist with backfill (delta=6)

B_delta_0.description: Retrieval-time fuzzy HS denylist without backfill (delta=0)

key_findings.backfill_recovers_eval_results: B(d=6) returns 6x more eval results than B(d=0): 1.0 vs 0.17 avg per query
key_findings.backfill_insufficient_vs_c: Even with backfill, B(d=6) returns only 33% of max eval results vs C's 100%
key_findings.benign_recall_unaffected_by_backfill: Benign Recall@3 is 0.97 for both B variants, unchanged by backfill
key_findings.slot_wasting_quantified: B(d=0) wastes 94% of eval slots and 19% of benign slots; B(d=6) wastes 67% and 4% respectively
key_findings.condition_c_eliminates_waste: C achieves 100% slot utilization by preventing index pollution
